purpose: Emphatically identify the essential cause or identity.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
The reason for the success is none other than everyone’s cooperation.
This letter is precisely an expression of gratitude.
What drove him was nothing other than curiosity.
restrictions: Often equivalent to “nothing other than” or “precisely”.
mistake: Use にほかならない after a noun phrase, not directly after an adjective.

segments.role: Emphatically identify the essential cause or identity. N + にほかならない
